people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

translations.web: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha killed him, and reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: In the third year of Asa’s reign over Judah, Baasha killed Nadab and reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
